models: Impedance by formula (Hammerstad-Jensen, Wheeler, conformal mapping for coplanar lines, IPC-2141); single and coplanar lines within about 2 %, offset striplines and differential pairs can be off by 5–15 %. Losses: Wheeler/Huray/Djordjevic-Sarkar. Lanes run from device pin to device pin through series parts (estimated parasitics); side stubs of the lane nets are open stubs (unused pads, parts not fitted with their pad capacitance, the other path of a fork). Pads: a track inside an SMD pad has the pad's width; the rest of a part's pad is a capacitance from the pad's cross-section (with what lies below it), else an estimate per package. Eye: PRBS7, linear transmitter/receiver from the profile (a termination next to the receiver acts as its termination), without equalisation, jitter and noise; the step response with a DC point and checks (band edge, response before arrival, settling, passivity) in its warnings. Pairs are 4-ports (both lines on their own paths, coupled where they run together): loss and return loss Sdd21/Sdd11, the eye driven differentially, mode_conversion_db (worst Scd21 up to 1.5 × Nyquist) as information. Multi-drop lines along one path: the eye at every receiver (receivers), the worst counts. One N-port Touchstone file behind a connector with a port map (connector_ends.<connector>.touchstone.ports): the connector's other lanes in it are worst-case aggressors (crosstalk_peak; they enter at the connector without their board traces – an estimate). Shunt parts on the lane's nets (capacitors to ground, …) are in the channel at their pads. Lanes from connector to connector: board share only (loss, return loss, skew, TDR), no eye. Lanes ending at a connector: board share – loss, return loss and skew judged; the eye with the connector end model (kisi.json connector_ends.<connector>, default the profile's receiver or transmitter at the connector) – information (eye_board_share), or judged when a channel behind the connector (rest_loss_db or a Touchstone file) is given.
not_checked_unused: 20 net(s) with a target only connect parts not fitted in this assembly (variant or DNP): not checked
